transcript: The new Porsche Taycan color which I just bought last month. Now look at this, what this new ChatGPT model Astra 6 did to it. I just gave it couple of images of my car, it searched the whole internet, went to Blender, and created this amazing super super detailed 3D render. I mean, just look at the detail here. And it didn't stop there. I added this Higgsfield plugin, gave this simple prompt, and check this out. So if you want the complete setup, just comment Porsche and I'll send you the link.
caption:
Still can’t believe ChatGPT Astra built this…

I gave astra 6 a few photos of my Taycan, it went and researched the car itself, then modeled it in blender. @higgsfield.ai took it from there and matched the camera moves into a speed ramp edit. 

Watch till the end to find the video.
